summary: A small box that unfolds into a rowboat or a keelboat.
text: A wooden box 12 inches long and 6 inches in both width and depth; it weighs 4 pounds, floats, and opens to hold things. It answers to three command words, each spoken as a Magic action: one unfolds it into a Rowboat, a second into a Keelboat, while the third collapses it back into a box, as long as nobody is on board. (In the game, it ferries the party across Barovia's lakes and rivers.)
